segments.ja288:1.1: Agghanti macchā adhikaṃ sahassaṃ, na so atthi yo imaṃ saddaheyya;
segments.ja288:1.3: Mayhañca assu idha satta māsā, ahampi taṃ macchuddānaṃ kiṇeyyaṃ.
segments.ja288:2.3: Taṃ dakkhiṇaṃ sarantiyā, kataṃ apacitiṃ tayā.
segments.ja288:3.1: Paduṭṭhacittassa na phāti hoti, na cāpi taṃ [naṃ (sī. syā.)] devatā pūjayanti;
segments.ja288:3.3: Yo bhātaraṃ pettikaṃ sāpateyyaṃ, avañcayī dukkaṭakammakārīti.
